name: Lore Distance Relationship
source:
Follow user StaircaseHaven14 on a Neopets-esque site called Ruffians as she faces life's challenges, RPs with her long-distance BFF (or more than BFF?) Bee, and encounters familial hardship, from age 8 to 18.

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/lore-distance-relationship]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟隨使用者名稱為StaircaseHaven14的女孩，見證她從八歲到十八歲的生活。在一個類似《尼奧寵物》的名為Ruffians的網站上，她一邊面對生活的挑戰，一邊和遠方的摯友（或者不只是摯友？）碧玩角色扮演，也經歷著家裡的種種難關。

［取自[url=https://norbez.itch.io/lore-distance-relationship]itch.io[/url]］
